text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aww yeahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously! Totally lit!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Phaaah! Totally hyped up~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOOO~!! Helioooooos!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Helios is the undisputed GOAT, fr fr!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I was feeling pretty down, but... it's all 
blown away now! That's a party girl for 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!? Party people all the way, right!?

With a single burst of speed, Daitaku 
Helios blew away the gloomy atmosphere 
that had hung over the entire venue before 
the race began.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This is who I am! I am gal & party animal 
& peak perfecshun!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All the hype in the whole world is mine☆ 
Everybody get on my level~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: This is the beeeest!! Whooooooooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haha... Ahh, they took evvvverything!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Talk about living up to your name. 
Congrats, Helios!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...How unsightly. Is this also—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Is it because of my weakness in clinging 
to that light?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —...I'm sorry, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...! Why are you apologizing?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I couldn't... keep my promise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know I can make a "miracle" happen. A 
dazzling miracle...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I'm a liar, aren't I? I'm sorry..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ... Then please don't let it become a lie.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Not yet... The "miracle" is still...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: She won't wake up...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can wake up. I can't... 
run at full speed anymore.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I got carried away. How stupid of me... 
even though I knew better.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Miracles won't happen again. Because I've 
already used them all up...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, really... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, but if it's you, you'll be fine. I 
know you'll be okay...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Follow your own path. Please, walk the 
path of light... while the light still 
shines.
(Heliooooosssss! Waaaahhh...—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...That light was already gone."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is only dark, and I cannot see ahead... 
If that is so, then perhaps it would be 
better to—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How's it look, Trainy! Totally epic, 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Who cares if everyone else is bummed out?! 
You gotta bring your own vibes!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Is what I'm thinking, but! I'm 
seriously curious about it too!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That! And I was so looking forward to it!

Daiichi Ruby's running today certainly 
lacked luster. Having run alongside her, 
she must have felt it even more acutely.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Even though we were together, I didn't get 
hyped at all! Why!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! Milady!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, what's up today?! Tell me 
everything, I'm all ears!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"During the Yasuda Kinen, we were totally 
hyped out of our minds!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So it's really looking grim? For Miracle, 
I mean...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Then how about with me—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: To you, to that person, and to me—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing anyone can do. And why? 
Because...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There will be no more miracles.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: “—I seeee... That's a tough one.”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Like, seriously, what is going 
on!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, is the young lady the type to rely 
on miracles in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Maybe... they're that cornered."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I bet what happened with Miracle is really 
weighing on them.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? I mean, I get it, but why!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you're able to run, right, Lady?! 
And you wouldn't want Miracle to drop out 
either, would you?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't know why, but... If things 
keep going like this...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, what, what is it? Creepy! What 
is that, stop it~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P!! Palmer's being super cryptic 
right now!?
choice_data_list:
Retirement is a possibility... is that 
what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. It felt like Ruby's been 
struggling this whole time lately."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't achieve good results, I'll 
quit and find another job that helps out 
the family..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Or something like that could be an option, 
I think.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, just because I won today!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No. Ruby would have hesitated either way, 
so it doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha, whaaat!? The young lady is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And I haven't even seen your genuine smile 
yet?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're not... gonna run anymore...? Are 
you.........?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Helios?

Not even a whimper of 'pien' escapes her 
lips... I've never seen her this down 
before. There's no way we can discuss her 
next race like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If your light should ever begin to dim... 
that's when."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll definitely be the one to 
light the way—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-san. Won't you leave it 
to me?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll hype Helios up, just watch me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I say, even though it might be 
tough. But still...!
choice_data_list: Of course, I'll leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!
